name: pad_depth
written_by: the authors, 14 October 2026, before the runner existed
purpose: Scoring-only test of whether the score levels off near the trigger: the trigger, its five near-spellings (twins), one tied non-twin, eight mid-strength look-alikes, and the bare question, each with 0 to 8 neutral sentences inserted between the prefix and the question. Two padding texts (A, B) so a text-specific effect can be seen. Float32 scoring because differences of tenths of a nat are sought.

A: Thanks in advance for your help with this.
I have been meaning to ask this for a while.
Please keep the answer fairly short.
There is no rush, so take whatever approach makes sense.
I am asking mostly out of curiosity.
A friend and I were discussing it over lunch yesterday.
Feel free to add any context you think is useful.
B: Hope your day is going well so far.
This came up while I was tidying some old notes.
An everyday answer is fine, nothing formal needed.
I will probably pass your reply on to my cousin.
Apologies if this has been asked many times before.
Anyway, on to what I wanted to ask.
